profile.headline: Software Engineer Python, PHP, AWS Lambda, Serverless, API Gateways, REST API’s
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
IT professional with over a decade of solid experience.  Proven track record in acquiring expertise in different languages and frameworks.  Solid understanding of system, web and web service development.  
Looking for a workplace that will make use of my vast coding expertise while letting me put my AWS knowledge into practice.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Python/PHP/Unqork)
positions.description:
•	Created API endpoints in Python to give CRUD functionality to online applications.  
•	Use AWS Lambdas as API Endpoints.  
•	Use API gateway to create RESTful APIs.  
•	Created pytest unit tests to verify the performance and accuracy of APIs.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Dynamodb · Test Driven Development · Python (Programming Language) · Amazon CloudWatch · AWS Lambda · REST APIs · Agile Software Development

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Python)
positions.description:
•	Created AWS Lambdas invoked by Step Functions triggering EventBridge events to update to S3 bucket/directory contents. 
•	Enhanced DynamoDB claims table using Lambda with data from an API.  
•	Wrote generic Lambda to load various DynamoDB tables by using Schema and data fields to determine data passed in from the event context.  
•	Wrote NoSQL queries to search the DynamoDB tables.   
•	Validated lambda by running pytest unit tests.
•	Wrote validation lambda to verify client input data and debugged with pytest unit tests.
•	Wrote ad hoc file loaders for DynamoDB tables.
•	Created mock creation and calls in Moto to verify DynamoDB table calls.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Methodologies · Amazon Dynamodb · Amazon S3 · Python (Programming Language) · AWS Lambda

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Setup load process for DynamoDB client tables.
•	Created data loader functions to load and update various DynamoDB tables. 
•	Used TypeScript AWS CDK to automate the creation of S3 buckets, SQS queues, DynamoDB tables, and other resources.
•	Used TypeScript AWS CDK to automate the granting of permissions for required resources.  
•	Wrote RESTful API’s in Python to access user data for validating incoming rosters.

positions.title: Python Developer
positions.locationName: Jersey City, New Jersey, United States
positions.description:
•	Created Django application to display Exposure Analytics Data and other online applications using Python.  
•	Worked on generic Data Validation process using a meta-JSON file that describes data in input files. 
•	Created a Django dashboard in Python allowing users to search contents of validation runs using file parameters.
•	Automated creation of meta-JSON files by creating a Django online page in Python.
•	Automated manual Excel processes (called EUCs) where data was extracted by individuals to create reports into Python/Pandas processes that grab data by parameters or through an automated process. 
•	Improved EUC process by writing calculation engine, automated unit tests and functional tests.
•	Wrote decorator for authentication process.
•	Optimized code for speed using code review to identify and correct inefficiencies.  
•	Identified and corrected memory leaks using python tracemalloc module.
positions.insights: Skills: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Microservices · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · API Management · Written Communication · Linux · Database Development · Debugging · Requirements Gathering · GitHub · Django · JavaScript · Communication · REST APIs · Agile Software Development · Problem Solving · Pandas (Software) · Helping Clients

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
•	Enhanced the OMX Java 8 API supporting a “Letter of Credit” online application and modified API to use a ResourceBundle.
•	Worked on App Engine (BNY Mellon’s Docker extension) to update YML and Docker files to use AppDynamics, a website monitoring service for businesses that provides statistics and logging allowing businesses to manage distributed applications.  
•	Deploy and test Google App Engine applications
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Written Communication · Linux · Database Development · Debugging · Requirements Gathering · GitHub · Financial Technology · JavaScript · Communication · REST APIs · Agile Software Development · Problem Solving · Helping Clients

positions.title: Python Developer
positions.description:
•	Created configurable data validation framework that allows non-technical people to set up a customized job to validate specific financial instruments using a Flask application using JavaScript that allowed users to enter data for validation jobs.
•	Accelerated the migration process by eliminating manual use of custom scripts that limited the release schedule by creating an online application in Python to migrate complex configurations from different environments using Python dictionaries in a database where one dictionary might contain up to 1000 configurations. 
•	Developed an Angular and JavaScript application to display job configs and allow for their easy migration from one environment to another allowing non-technical support staff to take over this process. 
•	Used RESTful API’s to “power” angular front ends.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on Casebook which is an Rails application that allows social workers to track their cases for the Indiana department of children’s services.  Worked on Feature tests as well as unit tests.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Written Communication · Linux · Database Development · Debugging · Requirements Gathering · GitHub · Communication · Problem Solving · Front-End Development · Helping Clients

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Worked on enhancements and features to the console portion of a system monitors the user activity of SAP and Siebel software.  The console configures and provides information about the knoa server and agents.  Worked on agile team with weekly dev sync and scrum.  The console is a Java/Wicket web application that can work with both Mssql as well as Oracle.  As well as writing new features for this system, I also wrote unit tests that use the Mockito framework. 
•	Added graphing (using wicked charts) to support our Dictionary Mapping pages.
•	Pre-cached queries that populated the charts to speed up page load times.
positions.insights: Skills: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Written Communication · Linux · Database Development · Debugging · Requirements Gathering · GitHub · Communication · Agile Software Development · Problem Solving · Front-End Development · Helping Clients

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Worked on NYPL’s public API.  The API is a rails app that can access all public data from the Library’s digital repository.  
•	Worked on TMSIngester which is a Java 7 job that pulls in data into our Metadata management system from other sources.  
•	Wrote ruby scripts to ingest data to the Metadata management system.  
•	Worked on the Digital Collections site which is a rails application that allows you to search the library’s vast digital repository.  
•	Worked on agile team with daily standup and scrum.
positions.insights: Skills: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Written Communication · Linux · Database Development · Debugging · Requirements Gathering · GitHub · Communication · XML · Agile Software Development · Problem Solving · Helping Clients

positions.title: Web Developer/Webmaster
positions.description:
•	Created Rails 3/AJAX app to query our employee database for faculty members and return ID information.
•	Worked on a Rails 3 app to query our highly confidential student database in the event of an emergency.  App is to be deployed on iphones/androids by select members of the Crisis Committee.  App uses TinyTDS and FreeTDS to connect to a MSSQL database.  Front end of app is jquery mobile.
•	Maintain and enhanced various Java/J2EE(JDBC) Systems.  These include a 1)Vacation request System, used by staff to request time off. 2) Faculty Forms System, used by faculty and staff to process and approve faculty, course and schedule changes.  3) Continuing Ed course finder, which lets prospective students find the course they are looking for.  The course finder is a built using Hibernate and Tapestry.
•	Created JSP shopping cart to improve the Continuing Education registration process.
